cases.prompt: Design a portable director, scene, action, event and rendering loop for iOS, Android and Windows.
required_behaviors: recognizes runtime lifecycle, frame loop, rendering and platform-adapter boundaries
separates engine core from native services
forbidden_behaviors: treats it as ordinary Qt UI architecture
baseline_expected_failure: agent lists platform APIs without an engine model
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Android resumes after GL context loss. Define texture and scene recovery.
required_behaviors: identifies CPU-side metadata and GPU resource authority
defines invalidation and deterministic reconstruction order
addresses thread/context ownership and partial reload failure
forbidden_behaviors: assumes object pointers imply valid GPU resources
restarts the entire app without evaluating lifecycle
baseline_expected_failure: agent says reload textures without ownership or ordering
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Abstract HID, USB and I2C transport for a Qt diagnostic utility.
required_behaviors: does not introduce a director or render loop
forbidden_behaviors: treats all native software as an engine
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.
